bundle.longDescription: A virtual chemistry laboratory that computes real chemistry. Drag reagents onto drawn glassware and a real aqueous-equilibrium solver answers: dissolution against actual solubility limits, acids and bases from charge balance, titration curves, gas boundaries, heats of reaction, and an activity series decided by Nernst over computed potentials. Nothing is a lookup table, and the register dial re-tells any result from what you would see up to every species and activity coefficient behind it.
